title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
items.abstract_or_text: We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature. Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prior literature on five problems: a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets, new exact 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11, new records for the discretized Kakeya needle and sign uncertainty problems, and a substantially improved lower bound for Erdős's minimum-overlap problem. Agents also discovered novel infinite families for Book Ramsey numbers. Importantly, the agents produced not only numerical constructions but also theorems and analyses explaining how those constructions work, making the results more interpretable and easier for mathematicians to build upon. We release all raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification code, providing a transparent record of how these discoveries emerged.
items.summary_zh: Station 在无中心协调者的开放式多智能体环境中进行数学探索，并公开对话、证明和验证代码。作者报告它在 12 个 AlphaEvolve 构造问题及两个案例中得到若干相对既有文献的新结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把数值构造、定理说明与可审查的过程记录放在同一公开材料中，便于区分可复算的发现与仍需数学界独立确认的新颖性主张。
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Station 中的自主数学发现；Station 是一个开放世界多智能体环境，不同模型家族的 AI 智能体在其中追求共同研究目标，且不存在中心协调者或预设流程。智能体自行选择研究方向、开展实验、协作并构建共享的科学文献。对于 AlphaEvolve 目录中的 12 个构造问题和另外两个案例研究，Station 在五个问题上获得了相对于既有文献的新结果：一个有限域 Kakeya 集的新无限族、11 维中新的精确 604 点 kissing 构型、离散化 Kakeya 针问题和符号不确定性问题的新纪录，以及 Erdős 最小重叠问题的显著改进下界。智能体还发现了 Book Ramsey 数的新无限族。重要的是，智能体不仅产出了数值构造，还产出了说明这些构造如何工作的定理和分析，使结果更具可解释性，也更便于数学家在其基础上继续研究。我们公开了全部原始智能体对话、证明和验证代码，提供这些发现如何产生的透明记录。
items.author_line: Stephen Chung, Wenyu Du, William J. Wesley

items.title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders
items.abstract_or_text: Multilingual language models can solve the same mathematical problem in different languages, but it remains unclear whether they rely on shared features or on language-specific computations that only produce similar outputs. We study this question in five models from four families using the Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) dataset, with problems solved in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese, retaining problems with valid reasoning traces in all six languages and replaying those traces through the model to record representations at multiple layers. For each model, we first use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to identify layers with cross-language alignment. At each selected layer, we train two sparse autoencoders (SAE): a baseline reconstruction-only model and a contrastive variant introduced in this work, the Geometry-Invariant SAE (GI-SAE). GI-SAE supplements the reconstruction loss with an Information Noise-Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) loss that trains the encoder to produce similar activations for traces of the same problem, regardless of language or token position. We then test whether the resulting shared features are functionally interchangeable by swapping their values between languages during the model's forward pass and measuring the resulting change in output, quantified by Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence per feature. Although GI-SAE yields higher CKA and Jaccard similarity at nearly every layer, higher geometric similarity does not consistently imply greater functional interchangeability. We find that cross-language feature sharing is model- and architecture-dependent in this sample and appears at different depths in different models. GI-SAE primarily amplifies cross-language structure already present: the pattern is model-specific, with strengthening in Qwen, no functional benefit in Gemma, and mixed layer-dependent effects in Llama and Phi.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 MGSM 的六种语言推理轨迹考察跨语言数学推理表征，并用激活互换检验共享特征是否真正可替代。结果显示，几何相似度升高并不稳定地意味着功能可替代。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将“多语言都答对”与内部计算是否共享分开测试，并报告了 Qwen、Gemma、Llama 与 Phi 之间并不一致的结果，避免把表征相似直接解读为同一推理机制。
items.abstract_zh: 多语言语言模型能够用不同语言解决同一个数学问题，但尚不清楚它们依赖的是共享特征，还是仅产生相似输出的语言特异性计算。我们使用 Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) 数据集，在四个家族的五个模型中研究这一问题：题目以英语、德语、法语、西班牙语、俄语和中文求解；我们保留在全部六种语言中都具有有效推理轨迹的题目，并将这些轨迹重新输入模型，以记录多个层级的表征。对于每个模型，我们首先使用 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 识别跨语言对齐的层。在每个选定层，我们训练两个稀疏自编码器 (SAE)：一个仅用于重构的基线模型，以及本文提出的对比变体 Geometry-Invariant SAE (GI-SAE)。GI-SAE 在重构损失之外加入 Information Noise-Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) 损失，训练编码器对同一题目的轨迹产生相似激活，而不受语言或 token 位置影响。随后，我们通过在模型前向传播中交换语言间这些特征的取值，并测量输出变化，来检验所得共享特征是否在功能上可互换；该变化以每个特征的 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度量化。尽管 GI-SAE 在几乎每一层都带来更高的 CKA 和 Jaccard 相似度，更高的几何相似度并不稳定地意味着更强的功能可互换性。我们发现，在此样本中，跨语言特征共享依赖于模型和架构，并在不同模型的不同深度出现。GI-SAE 主要放大了已经存在的跨语言结构：这一模式具有模型特异性，在 Qwen 中得到增强，在 Gemma 中没有功能收益，而在 Llama 和 Phi 中呈现随层而变的混合效应。

items.title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as code agents for scientific and engineering analysis, but their ability to analyze raw physical-layer measurements remains untested. We introduce EMRB (Electromagnetic Reasoning Benchmark), which evaluates whether LLMs can analyze raw I/Q data by writing and running code. EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated from 11 signal types with verified ground truth. Unlike benchmarks built on preprocessed features or structured tables, EMRB provides only the raw capture; the quantities each question refers to must first be discovered through code. We evaluate 14 LLMs spanning proprietary, open-weight, and reasoning-oriented families. Scores range from 24.1\% to 78.9\%, with the mean dropping from 84.9\% on basic measurement to 21.2\% on system design. We also propose ReconPilot, a structured method that separates signal reconnaissance, targeted analysis, and self-verification. Across three backbones, ReconPilot raises the overall score by 3.8 to 17.6 points and improves 13 of 15 backbone-level combinations tested. All data and code are publicly released in https://github.com/mingxuZhang2/EMRB{blue{our GitHub repository}}.
items.summary_zh: EMRB 用仅含原始 I/Q 捕获的数据测试模型能否通过编写和运行代码完成电磁信号分析；其 200 道题目具有已验证的标准答案，并比较 14 个 LLM。ReconPilot 在 15 个骨干模型组合中的 13 个带来提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 题目要求先从原始测量中定位所需量，而非直接读取整理好的特征；公开数据和代码使代码执行型推理的得分及误差模式可以复查。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型 (LLM) 日益被用作科学与工程分析的代码智能体，但其分析原始物理层测量数据的能力尚未得到检验。我们提出 EMRB (Electromagnetic Reasoning Benchmark)，评估 LLM 能否通过编写和运行代码来分析原始 I/Q 数据。EMRB 包含 200 道问题，覆盖五个难度等级和 27 类问题，从信号检测到 OFDM 设计；它们由 11 种信号类型生成，并具有经验证的标准答案。与基于预处理特征或结构化表格的基准不同，EMRB 只提供原始捕获数据；每个问题所指的量必须先通过代码发现。我们评估了 14 个 LLM，涵盖专有、开放权重和推理导向的模型家族。得分范围为 24.1% 至 78.9%，平均得分从基础测量的 84.9% 降至系统设计的 21.2%。我们还提出 ReconPilot，这是一种将信号侦察、定向分析和自验证分开的结构化方法。在三个骨干模型上，ReconPilot 将总体得分提高 3.8 至 17.6 分，并改善了 15 个骨干模型组合中的 13 个。全部数据和代码均已在 GitHub 仓库公开发布。
items.author_line: Mingxu Zhang, Ying Sun, Yuhan Li, Yang Ji, Dazhong Shen, Ke Zhang, Shan Huang

items.title: Evaluating Language Models on Cross-Language Code Functional Equivalence
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a variety of code-understanding tasks, leading many to believe that they can reason about program semantics. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on single-language settings or rely on synthetically generated code, raising concerns about whether current results reflect true semantic understanding. Aims: We investigate whether LLMs can accurately judge functional equivalence across different programming languages in human-written code, a setting that requires deeper reasoning beyond superficial similarity. Method: We introduce PolyHuman, a dataset of human-written programs in CPP, Java, and Python. Using this dataset, we evaluate intra- and inter-language equivalence detection across open-weight and proprietary LLMs, selecting GPT-o4-mini as a representative model to assess stability. We then manually analyze 81 cases of systematic disagreement in which models incorrectly judge functional equivalence, examining the code logic and the generated Chain-of-Thought reasoning. Finally, we categorize these failures and compare them across GPT-o4-mini, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3-Flash to determine whether they reflect model-specific issues or broader limitations of state-of-the-art LLMs. Results: We identify a difficulty-dependent breakdown in equivalence judgment (harder problems make the model increasingly prone to misclassifying non-equivalent code as equivalent), a model-specific sensitivity to programming language for the best-performing model (particularly a more conservative behavior on Python), and a partial reliance on similarity-based cues. GPT-o4-mini also shows substantial run-to-run instability under identical settings, indicating inconsistent rather than absent capability. Conclusions: Current LLMs do not reliably capture functional equivalence within or across languages.
items.summary_zh: PolyHuman 以人工编写的 C++、Java 与 Python 程序评估模型判断同语言及跨语言功能等价性的可靠性，并对 81 个系统性误判案例进行人工分析。结果显示，当前模型在困难等价性判断中并不稳定可靠。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 功能等价性可通过程序行为检验，比表面相似的代码理解更接近可验证的语义推理；该研究同时报告重复运行不稳定性和跨语言差异。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：大语言模型 (LLM) 已在多种代码理解任务中展示出较强表现，使许多人相信它们能够对程序语义进行推理。然而，现有评估主要聚焦单一语言场景或依赖合成生成的代码，这引发了当前结果是否反映真实语义理解的担忧。目标：我们研究 LLM 能否准确判断人工编写代码在不同编程语言间的功能等价性；这一场景要求比表面相似性更深入的推理。方法：我们提出 PolyHuman，一个包含 CPP、Java 和 Python 人工编写程序的数据集。利用该数据集，我们在开放权重和专有 LLM 上评估同语言与跨语言的等价性检测，并选取 GPT-o4-mini 作为代表模型来评估稳定性。随后，我们人工分析了 81 个模型错误判断功能等价性的系统性分歧案例，考察代码逻辑和生成的 Chain-of-Thought 推理。最后，我们对这些失败进行分类，并在 GPT-o4-mini、Claude-Opus-4.7 和 Gemini-3-Flash 间进行比较，以确定它们反映的是模型特异性问题还是当前最先进 LLM 更普遍的局限。结果：我们发现等价性判断会随难度提高而失效（更困难的问题使模型越来越容易将不等价代码错判为等价）；最佳模型对编程语言具有模型特异性的敏感性（尤其对 Python 表现得更保守）；并且模型部分依赖基于相似性的线索。GPT-o4-mini 在相同设置下也显示出显著的运行间不稳定性，表明其能力并非完全缺失，而是不一致。结论：当前 LLM 无法在同语言或跨语言场景中可靠地把握功能等价性。
items.author_line: Hui Sun, Anderson Uchôa, Rohit Gheyi, Wesley K. G. Assunção

items.title: NetConfArena: An Executable Benchmark for LLM Agents in Closed-Loop Network Configuration
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly attractive for automating network configuration, yet their reliability and failure patterns are poorly understood. An essential prerequisite is to assess such agents in a realistic but risk-free environment. Existing benchmarks, however, fall short: they often treat configuration as static command generation or rely on overly simplified settings. Such evaluations understate the core challenges of network configuration, where correctness requires reasoning about protocol complexity and topology dependence. We present NetConfArena, an executable benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in closed-loop network configuration. NetConfArena places agents in emulated multi-device networks, provides a standardized and compact action interface for task execution, and evaluates the resulting network behavior with hidden task-specific executable test cases. The benchmark relies on an LLM-assisted, emulation-grounded pipeline, which converts human-oriented network materials into reusable parameterized task templates. We evaluate representative LLM agents on 480 task instances instantiated from 96 protocol-focused task templates, yielding 3840 execution trajectories, and show that failures are not limited to command errors. The failures also reveal gaps in task-specification adherence and robust planning and execution. These findings suggest two future directions: using validated trajectories as supervision signals to improve foundation models, and designing harness mechanisms that make agent execution more reliable and accountable.
items.summary_zh: NetConfArena 在模拟的多设备网络中，以隐藏的可执行测试用例评估 LLM 智能体的闭环网络配置；研究运行了由 96 个协议任务模板实例化的 480 个任务和 3,840 条执行轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准用实际网络行为而非静态命令文本判定任务成功，能够暴露协议、拓扑、任务遵从和执行规划中的不同失败来源。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体越来越受到网络配置自动化的关注，但其可靠性和失败模式仍知之甚少。一个必要前提是在现实但无风险的环境中评估这类智能体。然而，现有基准存在不足：它们往往把配置视为静态命令生成，或依赖过度简化的设置。这类评估低估了网络配置的核心挑战，因为正确性要求对协议复杂性和拓扑依赖性进行推理。我们提出 NetConfArena，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体闭环网络配置能力的可执行基准。NetConfArena 将智能体置于仿真的多设备网络中，为任务执行提供标准化且紧凑的动作接口，并通过隐藏的、任务特异的可执行测试用例评估所得网络行为。该基准依赖一个由 LLM 辅助、以仿真为基础的流程，将面向人的网络材料转换为可复用的参数化任务模板。我们在由 96 个聚焦协议的任务模板实例化的 480 个任务实例上评估代表性 LLM 智能体，得到 3,840 条执行轨迹；结果显示，失败并不限于命令错误，还揭示了任务规格遵从、稳健规划和执行方面的缺口。这些发现提示两个未来方向：使用已验证轨迹作为监督信号来改进基础模型，以及设计使智能体执行更可靠、更可问责的机制。
items.author_line: Chang Liu, Xiaohui Xie, Xinyi Chen, Yong Cui

items.title: Robust Code RL via Faulty-Code-Driven Test case Synthesis and Dense Reward Shaping
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal technique for enhancing the code generation capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the efficacy of RLVR in coding implementations is fundamentally limited by the comprehensiveness of test cases, because insufficient test coverage in code validation often causes false positives, further leading to reward hacking and policy degradation. To mitigate the reward bias stemming from the suboptimal quality of current automated generation methods, we propose the RobustTests framework, which introduces a faulty-code-driven test case synthesis strategy that leverages "near correct" faulty codes to guide the model in precisely capturing latent logical discrepancies and further integrates validator agents with behavioral feature clustering to facilitate the granular filtering of invalid and redundant test cases. To address false negatives caused by inherent hallucination noise in synthetic test cases, RobustTests also incorporates a stepwise dense reward function based on pass rates, bolstering training robustness through fine-grained feedback. By employing this pipeline, we construct a high-quality dataset that augmented the test cases in CodeContests, encompassing a broader spectrum of faulty code scenarios and significantly enhances diagnostic utility. Experimental results demonstrate that, by leveraging a moderately challenging subset of problems from CodeContests for training, RL fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B via RobustTests achieves an absolute 3% performance gain on the LiveCodeBench benchmark compared to baseline methods, confirming the effectiveness of the RobustTests framework in advancing the code generation proficiency of LLMs.
items.summary_zh: RobustTests 从“近乎正确”的错误代码中合成测试用例，并用验证智能体和行为特征聚类筛除无效、冗余测试，以改善代码 RL 中可验证奖励的可靠性。在 LiveCodeBench 上，文中报告 Qwen3-32B 相对基线提高 3 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作直接处理测试覆盖不足造成的虚假通过和奖励投机，并在 CodeContests 增补测试集与独立代码基准上提供了可检验的训练结果。
items.abstract_zh: 来自可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 已成为增强大语言模型 (LLM) 代码生成能力的关键技术。然而，RLVR 在编码实现中的有效性从根本上受测试用例完备性限制，因为代码验证中测试覆盖不足常会造成假阳性，进而导致奖励投机和策略退化。为减轻当前自动生成方法质量不佳所引起的奖励偏差，我们提出 RobustTests 框架。该框架引入由错误代码驱动的测试用例合成策略，利用“近乎正确”的错误代码引导模型精确捕获潜在的逻辑差异；它还结合验证器智能体与行为特征聚类，细粒度地筛除无效和冗余测试用例。为处理合成测试用例固有幻觉噪声导致的假阴性，RobustTests 还引入基于通过率的逐步稠密奖励函数，通过细粒度反馈增强训练鲁棒性。利用这一流程，我们构建了一个高质量数据集，扩充了 CodeContests 中的测试用例，覆盖更广泛的错误代码情形，并显著提升诊断效用。实验结果表明，在 CodeContests 的一个中等难度问题子集上训练时，经 RobustTests 进行 RL 微调的 Qwen3-32B 在 LiveCodeBench 基准上相对基线方法获得 3% 的绝对性能提升，证实了 RobustTests 框架在推进 LLM 代码生成能力方面的有效性。
items.author_line: Yiwen Zhang, Xiaodong Yan, Zhenyu Huang, Deng Zhao, Liang Jiang, Qing Cui, Zujie Wen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou

items.title: Parason: Revealing Subtask and Trial Parallelism in LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Scaling test-time reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs), but standard autoregressive decoding still executes long reasoning traces sequentially, creating severe latency for difficult tasks (up to days and weeks). Parallel reasoning offers a natural remedy. However, prior systems primarily focus on Subtask Parallelism, where the model learns to decompose a high-level task into smaller chunks that can be solved independently. This approach overlooks another pervasive form of parallelism: Trial Parallelism, where multiple speculative attempts explore, verify, and aggregate competing hypotheses in parallel. In this paper, we introduce Parason, which reveals and learns both forms of parallelism in LLM reasoning. Our analysis identifies Trial Parallelism as the majority of parallelizable reasoning computation (65.5% in DeepSeek-V4's reasoning steps in HLE), and it becomes increasingly dominant on hard problems. Guided by this taxonomy, Parason converts sequential reasoning traces into structured parallel trajectories with a context-free grammar, then trains models with Parallelism-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO), whose reward jointly balances accuracy, latency, and the two parallelism ratios. At inference time, Parason executes the learned parallel structure through tool calls, translating theoretical savings to real-world wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks including AIME24 and AIME25 show that Parason achieves an average acceleration about 1.7\times while maintaining competitive accuracy.
items.summary_zh: Parason 将测试时推理中的并行机会区分为子任务并行和试验并行，并用上下文无关文法将顺序轨迹转换为并行轨迹。在 AIME24 与 AIME25 上，文中报告约 1.7 倍加速且保持有竞争力的准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它同时以准确率和实际墙钟时间评估推理并行化，并明确分析较难任务中不同并行形式的贡献，因而可检验“加速未显著损害解题表现”的主张。
items.abstract_zh: 扩展测试时推理已显著提高大语言模型 (LLM) 的解题能力，但标准自回归解码仍顺序执行长推理轨迹，给困难任务带来严重延迟，最长可达数天或数周。并行推理提供了一种自然的补救方法。然而，既有系统主要关注子任务并行，即模型学习将高层任务分解为可以独立求解的小块。这种方法忽略了另一种普遍存在的并行形式：试验并行，即多个推测性尝试并行地探索、验证和聚合竞争性假设。本文提出 Parason，揭示并学习 LLM 推理中的这两种并行形式。我们的分析发现，试验并行是可并行推理计算中的主要部分（在 HLE 的 DeepSeek-V4 推理步骤中占 65.5%），并且在困难问题上愈发占主导。受此分类法指导，Parason 通过上下文无关文法将顺序推理轨迹转换为结构化并行轨迹，然后用 Parallelism-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO) 训练模型；其奖励共同平衡准确率、延迟和两种并行比例。在推理时，Parason 通过工具调用执行学习到的并行结构，将理论节省转化为实际墙钟时间加速。在包括 AIME24 和 AIME25 在内的数学推理基准上，实验显示 Parason 在保持有竞争力准确率的同时实现约 1.7 倍的平均加速。
items.author_line: Zhengyang Zhang, Zijian Zhang, Jiaxuan Gao, Shusheng Xu, Yi Wu, Song Han, Ligeng Zhu

items.title: Recursive Agentic Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Test-time reasoning methods such as iterative refinement, decomposition, and repeated sampling are often evaluated in isolation, making their gains difficult to compare across models, benchmarks, and evaluation pipelines. We introduce a unified view of these methods as recursion operators over an agent's reasoning trace: GROW, which deepens a single reasoning path; PRUNE, which decomposes and recomposes the problem; and BRANCH, which samples alternative reasoning paths and selects among them. We evaluate all three operators against a single-pass chain-of-thought baseline under a shared harness with identical prompts, token budgets, and grading code. Across five benchmarks and three frontier models, comprising 14 model-benchmark settings, 49,327 graded items, and 151,876 model calls, BRANCH improves accuracy in all 14 settings by an average of 5.98 percentage points and is the best-performing operator in 12. In contrast, GROW yields a mean gain of 2.18 points and degrades performance in two settings, while PRUNE improves accuracy by 0.94 points on average. Analysis shows that BRANCH's advantage arises not only from exploring multiple reasoning paths, but also from recovering from truncation: its gains strongly correlate with the baseline rate of empty, budget-exhausted outputs (r = 0.72). These results weaken the hypothesis that different problems require routing among test-time reasoning operators; at this level of abstraction, repeated branching is consistently dominant. Finally, we show that unpaired evaluation and treating scoring-pipeline failures as model errors can materially change, and even reverse, comparative conclusions, motivating paired scoring as a standard protocol for test-time-compute evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在统一提示、token 预算和评分代码下比较 GROW、PRUNE 与 BRANCH 三种测试时递归推理算子。BRANCH 在 14 个模型—基准设置中均提高准确率，平均提高 5.98 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一评测框架和 49,327 个已评分条目使不同测试时推理策略可以直接比较；研究也量化了截断与评分流程故障如何影响结论。
items.abstract_zh: 迭代改进、分解和重复采样等测试时推理方法常被彼此孤立地评估，使其增益难以跨模型、基准和评估流程比较。我们将这些方法统一看作作用于智能体推理轨迹的递归算子：加深单一路径的 GROW，将问题分解后重组的 PRUNE，以及采样替代推理路径并从中选择的 BRANCH。我们在共享评测框架中，以相同提示、token 预算和评分代码，将三种算子都与单次 Chain-of-Thought 基线比较。跨越五个基准和三个前沿模型，共计 14 个模型—基准设置、49,327 个已评分条目和 151,876 次模型调用，BRANCH 在全部 14 个设置中提升准确率，平均提升 5.98 个百分点，并在其中 12 个设置中表现最佳。相较之下，GROW 平均提升 2.18 个百分点，并在两个设置中降低表现；PRUNE 平均提升 0.94 个百分点。分析显示，BRANCH 的优势不仅来自探索多条推理路径，也来自从截断中恢复：其收益与基线中空输出、预算耗尽输出的比例强相关（r = 0.72）。这些结果削弱了“不同问题需要在测试时推理算子之间路由”的假设；在这一抽象层面，重复分支始终占优。最后，我们表明，未配对的评估以及将评分流程故障视为模型错误，都可能实质性地改变、甚至颠倒比较结论，这说明配对评分应成为测试时计算评估的标准流程。
items.author_line: Shengxin Zhang, Xiaomin Wu, Xiyang Wu, Jing Xie

items.title: SA-Bench: Evaluating Semantic Alignment in LLM-Based Paper Reproduction
items.abstract_or_text: LLM agents can generate paper reproduction code, yet often produce scientifically unfaithful implementations. We define this failure mode as semantic drift, where generated code silently diverges from the paper's specifications. We introduce SemanticAlign-Bench(SA-Bench), a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 papers from ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS 2025. For each paper, we decompose its specifications into atomic and verifiable implementation claims, which we call Semantic Alignment Units (SAUs) and evaluate repositories along four diagnostic dimensions spanning numerical, methodological, protocol and ordering drift. In total, we construct 1,491 SAUs across five ML domains and evaluate 12 generator configurations (4 models \times 3 scaffolds). Even the strongest configuration (Claude+PaperCoder) achieves a mean SAU score of only 0.301 out of 1.0, with an overall mean of 0.221 across 360 evaluations. A failure taxonomy reveals that agents attempt most requirements but implement them incorrectly, with implementation mismatch and stubs accounting for the majority of zero-scored claims. Our analysis further indicates that scaffolds optimized for executability provide limited leverage for scientific reproduction; narrowing the gap requires scaffolds that prioritize semantic specification verification. The benchmark, annotations and evaluation pipeline are publicly available.
items.summary_zh: SA-Bench 将 30 篇顶会论文拆成 1,491 条可验证实现主张，诊断 LLM 复现代码的数值、方法、协议和顺序偏离。最强配置的平均 SAU 得分仅为 0.301，显示代码可运行并不等于科学复现忠实。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 评测把论文规范转为逐项可核对的主张，并公开基准、标注与评估流程，为检查生成复现实验是否忠于原始方法提供了具体尺度。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体能够生成论文复现代码，但常常产生在科学上不忠实的实现。我们将这种失败模式定义为语义漂移，即生成的代码在不易察觉的情况下偏离论文规范。我们提出 SemanticAlign-Bench (SA-Bench)，这是一个诊断性基准，覆盖 ICLR、ICML 和 NeurIPS 2025 的 30 篇论文。对于每篇论文，我们将其规范分解为原子化且可验证的实现主张，称为 Semantic Alignment Units (SAUs)，并从数值、方法、协议和顺序漂移四个诊断维度评估代码库。总计，我们在五个机器学习领域构建了 1,491 个 SAU，并评估 12 种生成器配置（4 个模型 × 3 种脚手架）。即使最强配置 Claude+PaperCoder 的平均 SAU 得分也仅为 0.301（满分 1.0）；360 次评估的总体平均值为 0.221。失败分类表明，智能体会尝试大多数要求，但实现错误；实现不匹配和占位代码构成零分主张的大多数。我们的分析还表明，为可执行性优化的脚手架对科学复现帮助有限；缩小差距需要优先考虑语义规范验证的脚手架。该基准、标注和评估流程均已公开。
items.author_line: Xue Hu, Zewei Pan, Zeli Su, Zhou Liu, Wentao Zhang

items.title: A Theory of Speciation in Generative Diffusion Models on Compact Riemannian Manifolds
items.abstract_or_text: Speciation in generative diffusion models denotes the emergence of distinct stable branches during denoising, through which initially undifferentiated trajectories progressively commit to different data classes. In this work we develop an intrinsic theory of speciation for diffusion models supported on compact Riemannian manifolds: the aim is to go beyond existing theoretical descriptions, which usually identify speciation with a symmetric pitchfork bifurcation and assume to work in a large-dimensional space. We characterize speciation by bifurcations of the critical points of the evolving probability density. A spectral heat-kernel representation makes explicit the role of the manifold geometry, while Poincaré-Hopf and Morse theory impose global constraints on the number and type of score equilibria and reveal topologically-imposed geometrical modes. For mixtures of heat kernels, we prove that generic speciation events have a one-dimensional critical kernel and admit an A2 fold normal form; pitchforks and simultaneous multidirectional transitions arise from nongeneric symmetric configurations. We derive geometry-dependent estimates of speciation times for bimodal mixtures and Riemannian regular simplices. We further establish structural stability of nondegenerate folds under score perturbations and show that the first-order time shift is determined solely by the component of the score error along the critical direction. The theory is illustrated on the sphere using mixtures of von Mises-Fisher distributions, where pitchfork and saddle-node bifurcations, topological modes, and hierarchical multiple speciations are observed. Finally, a chart-based intrinsic score-learning scheme based on neural networks contrasts the theoretically predicted transitions on prototypal and more complex datasets.
items.summary_zh: 该理论工作在紧致 Riemann 流形上刻画扩散模型去噪过程中的分支形成，利用热核表示、Poincaré-Hopf 定理、Morse 理论和分岔正规形给出可分析的条件与稳定性结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将生成扩散模型中的类分化现象转化为临界点与分岔的数学问题，并给出明确的定理性主张；这些证明仍应以论文全文和后续同行审查为准。
items.abstract_zh: 生成扩散模型中的分化（speciation）指在去噪过程中出现不同稳定分支的现象：起初未分化的轨迹通过这些分支逐步趋向不同数据类别。在本文中，我们为支撑在紧致 Riemann 流形上的扩散模型发展了一套内蕴的分化理论；目标是超越现有理论描述，后者通常将分化等同于对称叉形分岔，并假定在高维空间中工作。我们用演化概率密度临界点的分岔来刻画分化。谱热核表示明确了流形几何的作用，而 Poincaré-Hopf 和 Morse 理论对 score 平衡点的数目和类型施加全局约束，并揭示由拓扑强制的几何模态。对于热核混合物，我们证明一般的分化事件具有一维临界核，并允许 A2 折叠正规形；叉形分岔和同时的多方向转变源于非一般的对称构型。我们推导了双峰混合物和 Riemann 正单形的依赖几何的分化时间估计。我们还建立了非退化折叠在 score 扰动下的结构稳定性，并表明一阶时间偏移仅由 score 误差沿临界方向的分量决定。该理论在球面上用 von Mises-Fisher 分布混合物加以说明，其中观察到叉形和鞍结分岔、拓扑模态以及分层的多重分化。最后，一种基于神经网络、以图表为基础的内蕴 score 学习方案，在原型和更复杂数据集上对比了理论预测的转变。

review.note: 选出 9 项公开 arXiv 预印本。入选工作均给出了明确任务与可复查的评测、代码或证明材料；数学新发现及模型能力结论仍应视为预印本作者报告。
